mapper.select: SELECT id, title, introduction AS description, banner, is_following AS isFollowing, followers_count AS followersCount, view_count AS viewCount, updated, category FROM t_special WHERE category = #{category} ORDER BY updated DESC

SELECT id, title, introduction AS description, banner, is_following AS isFollowing, followers_count AS followersCount, view_count AS viewCount, updated, category FROM t_special ORDER BY updated DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
